page.overview:
Who is Alkadi Nasreen?

Alkadi Nasreen, self-styled Caliph of Mahabbah, and Lord of the Twin Seas, is an Arabyan corsair and Caliph of the citadel of Arjijil. His fame has undoubtedly spread to the Estalian Kingdoms. He demands tribute from foreign vessels with the exception of those guaranteed safe passage by the Sultan of All Araby, thanks to his seal, or at least in most cases.

The sand-sea of the Sahra was the second of those "twins" over which the Caliph of Mahabbah claim his lordship, but any such claim is mere fancy as the desert is no man’s realm.

For who knows him better, Alkadi was an Estalian who had taken the turban in order to rule his nest of pirates, and that in giving up the gods of his own folk he had become entirely godless in his most secret thoughts.

Although due to his skin tanned by the Arabyan sun and his eyes were equally dark, Alkadi Naseen could easily be taken by one of the desert men, someone with the expert eye could guess that he was not originally from the region. Despite being a famous corsair and ruler of Araby, Alkadi was originally from Estalia, specifically from Zaragoz, being baptized with another name, although he abandoned it for the one he holds today. In addition to parents, he had a sister and a brother, although with the latter he had a conflictive relationship, which ended up leading to mutual hatred and contempt, taking very different paths.
